title: Rupee climbs 1% to 95.76 vs USD after RBI moves to curb dollar demand
excerpt: The rupee surged 1% to 95.76 against the dollar at Monday’s open after the RBI introduced measures to curb dollar demand and speculative activity. title: Supreme Court asks MMRDA to deposit Rs 646 crore in Reliance Industries BKC case
excerpt: The Supreme Court has ordered the MMRDA to deposit Rs 646 crore with its registry by November 6. This order is in relation to a delay in construction by Reliance Industries at Bandra-Kurla Complex. Additionally, the court has issued a notice to Reliance Industries promoted by Mukesh Ambani. The MMRDA is challenging a Bombay High Court order that quashed an earlier demand against the company.

title: Banks seek RBI relief, clarity on India's latest rupee-defence measures: Report
excerpt: Banks have approached the Reserve Bank of India to request changes to the 20% cash deposit mandate. They propose that a flat charge replaces the deposit requirement for current-account hedging. This change could improve liquidity while ensuring cost transparency for businesses. Lenders also highlighted concerns over the $2 million threshold, which complicates hedge tracking. Clarity is needed regarding the deposit requirement for hedges related to interest payments on foreign loans.

title: Cheap Venezuelan crude could add up to Rs 12,600 crore to RIL’s EBITDA. What investors should know

title: Equity mutual funds inflow surges 31% to ₹38,306 crore in September
excerpt:
Equity mutual fund schemes attracted a net inflow of Rs 38,306 crore in September, rising 31 per cent from the preceding month, driven by strong investor interest in mid-cap and small-cap funds despite underperformance in the equity market.
The inflow was higher than Rs 29,329 crore recorded in August, according to data released by the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) on Monday.
Among equity categories, small-cap funds attracted the highest net inflow of Rs 9,039 crore, followed by mid-cap funds at Rs 7,835 crore. Large-cap funds, meanwhile, saw net inflows of Rs 860 crore during the month.

title: RBI's liquidity move lifts weighted average call money rates by 12 bps
excerpt:
The Reserve Bank's liquidity measures announced last week to drain surplus from the banking system lifted weighted average call money rates by 0.12 per cent on Monday, experts said.
The measures, including moves to increase the daily CRR maintenance limit to 99 per cent and bond sales through open market operations, will also help accelerate rate hike transmission, they said.
The weighted average call money rate on Monday stood at 5.43 per cent against 5.31 per cent on October 9, according to the Clearing Corporation of India's (CCIL) data.

title: India benchmark bond posts worst day in six months on RBI measures

ai.market_impact_te: బ్యాంకింగ్ రంగంలో వేతన ఖర్చు మార్పు తక్షణంగా స్టాక్ ధరలను ప్రభావితం చేయకపోయినా, దీర్ఘకాలంలో ఖర్చు నిర్మాణాన్ని మార్చవచ్చు.
ai.impact_reason_te: HSBC వంటి పెద్ద బ్యాంక్ వేతన నిర్మాణంలో మార్పు, ఇతర గ్లోబల్ బ్యాంకుల వేతన విధానాలను ప్రభావితం చేయవచ్చు; ఇండియన్ బ్యాంకులు కూడా ఇలాంటి మార్పులను అనుసరించవచ్చు, ఇది ఆపరేటింగ్ ఖర్చు, లాభదాయకతపై ప్రభావం చూపుతుంది.

title: Rupee rebounds nearly 1% after RBI moves to curb speculative trades
excerpt: The rupee rebounded nearly 1% to 95.77 per dollar on Monday after the RBI announced measures to curb speculative currency trades. A special window for state-owned oil marketing companies eased spot-market pressure, though dollar buying by importers and corporates capped gains. Elevated crude prices and global uncertainties continue to weigh on the currency.

title: SBI economists call for scrapping LTCG tax on equities
excerpt: SBI economists are advocating for the elimination of long-term capital gains tax to stimulate sustained investment in Indian equity markets. This proposal arises amid substantial foreign portfolio investor withdrawals exceeding Rs 3 lakh crore this year, prompting concerns. Furthermore, the lack of AI-focused stocks is contributing to these market exits.

ai.title_te: SBI ఆర్థికవేత్తలు LTCG ట్యాక్స్ రద్దు కోరారు, విదేశీ పెట్టుబడిదారుల నిష్క్రమణ తగ్గించడానికి

ai.market_impact_te: FII ప్రవాహం పునరుద్ధరించడానికి, NIFTY‑SENSEXలో బుల్లిష్ మూడ్ ఏర్పడే అవకాశం.
ai.impact_reason_te: LTCG ట్యాక్స్ రద్దు ద్వారా పెట్టుబడిదారుల after‑tax రిటర్న్ పెరుగుతుంది, ఇది విదేశీ పోర్ట్‌ఫోలియో పెట్టుబడిదారుల (FII) ఆకర్షణను పెంచి, మార్కెట్ లిక్విడిటీని బలపరుస్తుంది.

title: Jubilant Pharmova block deal: Quant Mutual Fund offloads Rs 190 crore stake amid Rs 800 crore fundraising plan; Abakkus buys 11 lakh shares
excerpt: Quant Mutual Fund sold 20.81 lakh shares of Jubilant Pharmova worth Rs 190.47 crore in bulk deals, while Abakkus Four2Eight Opportunities Fund bought 11 lakh shares. The transactions came as the pharmaceutical company approved plans to raise up to Rs 800 crore through non-convertible debentures and seek broader debt issuance authorisation.

title: Singularity AMC pays over Rs 40 lakh to settle AIF rule violation case with Sebi
excerpt: Singularity AMC, a company rooted in Mumbai, has successfully resolved two significant matters with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) concerning violations related to alternative investment funds. title: Indian Gas Exchange secures Sebi's nod to float IPO
excerpt: Indian Gas Exchange Ltd has received approval from Sebi to launch an initial public offering. The proposed IPO is exclusively an offer for sale of equity shares by promoter Indian Energy Exchange Ltd. ai.market_impact_te: NIFTY 50 లో బ్లూ-చిప్‌ల బరువు తగ్గడంతో ఇండెక్స్ దిగజారే అవకాశం, చిన్న‑క్యాప్ స్టాక్స్‌లో కొనుగోలు ఆసక్తి పెరుగుతుంది.
ai.impact_reason_te: FII విక్రయాలు లార్జ్‑క్యాప్ స్టాక్స్‌కి నిధి ప్రవాహాన్ని తగ్గిస్తాయి, అందువల్ల మార్కెట్ క్యాపిటలైజేషన్ వాటా తగ్గి, చిన్న‑క్యాప్ కంపెనీలకు రిస్క్‑అడ్జస్టెడ్ రిటర్న్ మెరుగుపడుతుంది.
